# LatticeTerm

> Keep local AI coding assistants and remote terminals in one desktop workspace. Organize native-PTY sessions by project and switch between agents, SSH, and file transfers.

## Source map

- React application shell and views: `src/App.tsx`, `src/views/`
- Local AI CLI PTY backend: `src-tauri/src/agent.rs`
- Agent UI and terminal: `src/views/AgentsView.tsx`, `src/components/agents/`
- SSH, SFTP and tunnels: `src-tauri/src/ssh.rs`, `sftp.rs`, `tunnel.rs`
- Lattice Remote: `src/components/remote/`, `src-tauri/src/remote.rs`, `crates/lattice-remote/`
- RDP and VNC engines: `crates/lattice-rdp/`, `crates/lattice-vnc/`
- Vault, backup and storage: `src-tauri/src/vault.rs`, `backup.rs`, `storage.rs`

## Important boundaries

- AI CLI credentials remain owned by each CLI and are not stored by LatticeTerm.
- Remote connections use real backends; planned capabilities are labelled rather than simulated.
- Lattice Remote supports direct endpoint pairing and a self-hosted lattice-relay: permanent nine-digit device IDs reachable across networks, end-to-end encrypted with the relay forwarding ciphertext only. NAT hole-punching is planned, not implemented.
